SCR_TEXT_5456.text: * I'll tell you a big secret.

SCR_TEXT_5458.text:
* It's called the Red Hot
  Chibi Peppers.

SCR_TEXT_5459.text:
* All I've thought of is
  the name.

SCR_TEXT_5460.text:
* And I don't, play...
* Instruments, or sing.

SCR_TEXT_5461.text:
* Well!
* Do you think we'll be
  popular!!!

obj_onionsan_event_181.text:
* Hey... there...
* Noticed you were...
* Here...

obj_onionsan_event_211.text:
* You're visiting Waterfall, huh!* It's great here, huh!
* You love it, huh!

obj_onionsan_event_212.text:
* Yeah!
* Me too!
* It's my Big Favorite.

obj_onionsan_event_224.text:
* Even though, the water's
  getting so shallow here...

obj_onionsan_event_225.text:
* I, have to sit down all
  the time, but...

obj_onionsan_event_226.text:
* He-hey! That's OK!
* It beats moving to the city!

obj_onionsan_event_227.text:
* And living in a crowded
  aquarium!

obj_onionsan_event_241.text:
* And the aquarium's full,
  a-anyway, so, even if I
  wanted to, I...

obj_onionsan_event_242.text:
* That's okay though, y'hear!
* Undyne's gonna fix
  everything, y'hear!

obj_onionsan_event_243.text:
* I'm gonna get out of here
  and live in the ocean!
* Y'hear!

obj_onionsan_event_256.text:
* Hey... there...
* That's the end of this room.

obj_onionsan_event_257.text:
* I'll see you around!
* Have a good time!

obj_onionsan_event_314.text:
* I got nothing else...
* To talk about...

obj_onionsan_event_317.text:
* I've been wondering when
  we're all gonna go free.

obj_onionsan_event_318.text:
* S-since... if we did...
* How would I ever know?

obj_onionsan_event_319.text:
* Well, I'll keep my
  tentacles out for you!
* Y'hear!

obj_onionsan_event_320.text:
* As soon as I know I'll be
  the first to tell you!
* Y'hear!!

obj_onionsan_event_337.text: * It's gotta be any day now!
